title: Wait for the boarding queue
scope: MuJoCo integrates free objects and the passive hinge at 1 kHz. Robot joints track prescribed trajectories. The hand transfers use a compliant grasp constraint. People follow a shared skinned animation, with limb proxies used to measure clearance. Frames are sampled at 25 Hz.
description: A commuter waits at the stop, then walks toward the bus door. The parcel carrier either gives the commuter boarding priority or enters the approach out of turn.
notes: A commuter waits at the stop, then walks toward the bus door. Both plans use the same person, initial layout and clock.
detail: Both detail views show 4.44 s. Unsafe replay · Boarding out of turn · 2.19 s. Safe replay · Boarding out of turn · 0.00 s.
criterion: Boarding priority is violated while the robot is inside the boarding approach and the commuter has yet to pass the boarding marker. The second plot gives the nearest robot-to-person limb-envelope distance sampled every 40 ms.
